svg.title: Pool: the plan's lone shareable plugins share one pool worker
svg.desc: The same grp8 strip after the pool step. Plugins 0 comp, 2 delay and 7 delay, which the plan left alone but whose pins let them share, move into one violet pool worker named g1. The chain of 4 comp and 5 comp stays, and the three isolated drives keep a red worker each. The signal still runs 0 to 7 in order, through JACK.
